info.title: HandyApp API
info.description: Generated from the registered routes (TSK-0010, HH-API-01). Errors use one envelope (HH-API-03); private responses are not cached.

get.description: For a live customer session: the references of the projects it opens (a guest link session: exactly one). Without a session, 401. Nothing about any other project, account or history.

get.summary: The opened project at a glance
get.description: The project of the caller’s session, as the customer sent it: its reference, the services by their registry names, when it was sent and the request’s state code. A customer projection only (HH-PORT-01): no internal note, staff detail or other record. Any other project, an unknown reference or a malformed one is the same NOT_FOUND (T19), and the refusal is logged (AUTHZ_DENIED).

The verified customer of the request’s project (TSK-0037: read inside the session’s scope). The photos the customer may see, each with its state: what the customer uploaded and what staff shared with them; internal and restricted photos are not found by URL or ID (HH-DATA-07). Ready photos carry a signed URL valid for minutes; quarantined and rejected photos are never served.

post.summary: Send or resend the code for an access link
post.description: Sends a one-time code (the automatic message contact.verification_code) for a live grant to its own contact: by email, or by text with that request’s current SMS opt-in. The code lifetime and the attempt, resend and per-address limits come from session.timings and verification.limits: a resend inside the cooldown or over a limit is a neutral 429 with Retry-After; while the code key or those values are NOT CONFIGURED, 503 and nothing is sent. A phone without the opt-in is a 400 (sms_not_permitted).

post.summary: Open the project with the link and its code
post.description: The explicit verified exchange (HH-ID-05): the code of the channel’s latest send for this grant. A match records the exact value as verified on the contact, records the grant’s verified time and starts a new customer session for the grant’s one project (Set-Cookie; any earlier session of this browser ends). Other projects of the same customer, email or phone are never attached (HH-ID-03). A wrong, expired, replaced, used or exhausted code is one neutral 400 (body.code, invalid_code); the attempt is counted and kept, so the configured attempt limit holds.

The visitor pressed Open on the access page (HH-ID-05). For a live grant: where its one-time code can go, masked (the grant’s own contact; the phone only by text with that request’s current SMS opt-in). Nothing else: no scope, address, financial detail or photo, and nothing changes (no code, no session, no consumption). An unknown, malformed, expired or revoked link is NOT_FOUND.

get.description: Guest or customer. The outcome for a ZIP (in_coverage, boundary, out_of_coverage or unknown) and its message, from the active coverage rule set; unknown while no rule set is active (configured: false). Area eligibility only: never an appointment, availability, price or travel charge, and never a reason to refuse a request.

post.description: Creates an upload capability scoped to one new draft, valid for the configured request-draft period (session.timings.requestDraftDays). The token is returned once; the server keeps only its hash. Also returns the configured photo limits (uploads.limits). It reaches no customer record, other draft or object list.

get.summary: The photos of an upload draft
get.description: The capability's own photos with their states (quarantined while processing, ready, rejected).

post.description: Raw JPEG, PNG or WebP bytes under the Upload-Capability header. The server checks the real content, the declared type, the size and the count against uploads.limits, stores the original once in the private bucket and quarantines it until processing passes it. The same bytes again return the same photo. Problems: 413 too large, 415 not an allowed image, 400 with a field error (type_mismatch, malformed, trailing_data, unsafe_content, too_many, empty).

delete.description: Removes one of the capability’s own draft photos before submission. The stored original is kept.

get.description: Public read of the configured request-draft period (session.timings.requestDraftDays, FACT-SESSION-TIMINGS), the business time zone, the service limit and the photo limits (uploads.limits). draftDays is null while the value is NOT CONFIGURED; the wizard then keeps no draft. TSK-0028: the visit hours (contact.hours, FACT-HOURS), the preferred windows offered with their configured hours (request.window_hours; no hours while NOT CONFIGURED) and whether estimates are free (estimate.visit_fee, FACT-VISIT-FEE). Preferences only: nothing here is availability, a slot or a price. TSK-0032: the response target in minutes (response.target, FACT-RESPONSE-TARGET), which the receipt’s "What happens next?" wording states with the visit hours; null while NOT CONFIGURED (the receipt then states no response time).

post.summary: No thanks to Create an Account
post.description: Records that the guest declined the optional account offer (HH-INT-14). It changes nothing else: the request, its contact and verification states, the project and the receipt capability stay exactly as they were, and guest access to the project is never reduced by it.

get.description: Under the Receipt-Capability header: the request's own email and phone, masked, each with its own verification state (unverified, pending, verified, expired, failed), whether a code can be sent on it (texts need this request’s SMS opt-in), and an email change waiting for its code. Never another record, account or history.

post.summary: Send or resend a verification code
post.description: Sends a one-time code (the automatic message contact.verification_code, OWN-DEC-150) to the request’s email or, with this request’s SMS opt-in, by text to its phone. With `destination` (email only, while unverified) the code goes to the new address and the contact changes only when that code is entered (Change Contact). The code lifetime and the attempt, resend and per-address limits come from session.timings and verification.limits (TSK-0016): a resend inside the cooldown or over a limit is a neutral 429 with Retry-After; while the code key or those values are NOT CONFIGURED, 503 and nothing is sent. Refusals: 400 with already_verified, sms_not_permitted, invalid_destination or change_not_available.

Checks the code of the channel’s latest send. A match marks that exact value verified (an email change then replaces the old address); the other channel is never touched. A wrong, expired, replaced, used or exhausted code is the same neutral 400 (field body.code, invalid_code); the attempt is counted and kept (the refusal commits), so the configured attempt limit holds. Verifying links nothing to any other record. TSK-0034: a match also starts this browser’s customer session for the request’s one project (Set-Cookie; projectAccess true), from the project’s live access grant; a verified email change first revokes the project’s grants and their sessions and issues a new grant. Without a usable grant, projectAccess is false.

Guest or customer submission. One transaction creates a new customer, contact, property, project (not a job or appointment) and the request with its services and answers, plus one request.submitted outbox event. Never matched to existing customers. The same Idempotency-Key returns the same request; a changed body is a 409. Rate limited per client network with a neutral 429. Spam signals only flag the request for review. TSK-0032: when the draft’s photos were bound, the Upload-Capability response header carries a new capability scoped to this request’s photos only (token returned once, never stored with the replayable response), so the receipt can show their states and retry a failed photo without a new request (HH-INT-07, HH-INT-12). TSK-0033: the Receipt-Capability response header carries the receipt page’s capability for this request’s own contact verification and account-offer answer (returned once; a replayed response carries neither header). TSK-0034: the same transaction issues the project’s single-project access grant (HH-ID-04; token stored only as a hash), whose secure access link the automatic message project.access_link sends from request.submitted.

get.summary: Services and their questions for the request form
get.description: Public read of the registry services the public site may show (production: approved and published; other environments: staging or published), each with its registry name, category and the questions from its intake inputs. Draft services are never listed.

Public read of the configured facts the public site shows: the brand (business.name, FACT-BRAND-IDENTITY), the public phone and email (business.public_contact, FACT-PUBLIC-CONTACT) and the accepted payment method codes (payment.methods, FACT-PAYMENT-METHODS). A value that is NOT CONFIGURED is null, never a default.

post.summary: Revoke every session of a staff member
post.description: Owner only (ROLE-MATRIX staff.revoke_sessions; protective, never delayed by a fresh sign-in or a reason). Every session of the staff member ends at once; their history is kept.

get.summary: MFA status of the signed-in staff member
get.description: Whether an authenticator is enrolled and how many recovery codes are left. Never a secret.

post.summary: Confirm the authenticator and get recovery codes
post.description: Checks a code from the new authenticator, enables MFA, ends the user's other sessions, rotates this one and returns 10 single-use recovery codes once.
Needs fresh authentication. Removes the authenticator and the recovery codes and ends the user's other sessions.
Needs fresh authentication. Returns the TOTP secret and otpauth URI once, for the authenticator app; enrolment completes only with a confirming code.

post.summary: Complete sign-in with the authenticator or a recovery code
post.description: For a session waiting for its second factor: a valid TOTP code or an unused recovery code completes it with a new session token. Rate limited; failures are audited.

post.summary: Forgot password: email a reset link
post.description: Always answers 202 the same way. When the email belongs to an account that is not disabled, a single-use reset link (valid per session.timings) is emailed through the outbox. Rate limited per email and per network.

post.summary: Set a password with an invite or reset link
post.description: Consumes the single-use link, checks the length-based policy, stores the argon2id hash, activates an invited account and revokes every session: the person then signs in again.

post.summary: Enter the password again for a sensitive action
post.description: Fresh authentication (HH-STAFF-03): a correct password, or the authenticator code when MFA is enrolled, rotates the session (new token and CSRF token) and marks it freshly authenticated. Rate limited; failures are audited.

get.description: The current session: name, email, locale, roles and the MFA recommendation. Never a hash.

put.summary: Choose the staff language (English or Spanish)
put.description: Stores the signed-in staff member's own locale on their staff identity, so it follows them across devices and sessions (HH-OPS-04, ENT-StaffUser: each user edits only their own locale). It changes staff screens and staff notifications only, never customer messages or documents (HH-LANG-03).

post.description: Revokes every session of the signed-in staff member, this one included, and clears the cookie.

post.summary: Staff sign-in with email and password
post.description: Verifies the password (argon2id, equal timing for unknown emails), starts a new session (new ID) and sets the host-only session cookie. Rate limited per account and per network. Sign-in and failed sign-in are audited.
Revokes the current session on the server and clears the cookie. Always available to a signed-in user.

get.description: Staff with customer.view (Owner, Office; Estimator PROPOSED). Customers newest first inside the caller’s scope, optionally searched by name, exact email, phone or project reference. Each shows its primary contact, city, project count and, for roles holding customer.view_duplicates, its open duplicate suggestions (never links).

Staff with customer.view, inside their scope. The customer with each contact (email and phone verification separately, preferred channel, the SMS opt-in and the separate marketing permission with their records, opt-outs included), authorized properties, projects and requests, notes with their visibility class (a restricted note is masked for a role that may not read it; an Owner reading restricted incident detail is audited), duplicate suggestions for roles holding customer.view_duplicates (suggestions only, never links), and the activity history. Documents and payments are not available in this release. The ETag is the customer version.

put.description: Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). A written reason is required from everyone; the change is kept with the values before and after (staff only). If-Match is the customer version. A merged record is not edited (CUSTOMER_MERGED).

post.description: Staff with customer.merge (Owner; Office with a reason) and customer.view_duplicates (PROPOSED: whoever decides merges decides that a suggestion is not one). Marks an open suggestion of this customer as reviewed and not the same customer, with a required reason; nothing is linked or changed on either customer. The pair reopens only if the two later share new details. If-Match is the suggestion version.

put.description: Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). Name, email, phone and preferred channel, with a required reason; the change is kept with the values before and after (staff only). A changed email or phone is unverified until the contact verifies that exact value (verification belongs to the value, OWN-DEC-96); its open codes stop working. Text as the preferred channel needs a current SMS opt-in for the number (HH-INT-22). A changed email or phone is checked for duplicate suggestions (never links). If-Match is the contact version.

post.description: Staff with customer.edit (Owner; Office with a reason). Records the customer’s instruction to stop texts (the SMS opt-in) or marketing on one channel, as an append-only consent record (source staff_recorded) that the send-time checks honour at once. Staff never record an opt-in for the customer (PROPOSED: the customer gives it on the form or in the portal). Already withdrawn: nothing new is recorded.

post.summary: Add a note to a customer record
post.description: Staff with request.add_note (PROPOSED: notes on the customer record sit with request notes). A staff-only note with its visibility class: internal_operational by default, or restricted_incident (the Owner and the reporting worker only) or restricted_financial. A note is never customer-shared: customer-visible text is a customer message. Notes are never edited or deleted, never hold card numbers (refused) and their text is never audited.

post.summary: Invite a staff member with a role
post.description: Owner only, with fresh authentication (ROLE-MATRIX staff.invite). Creates an invited account with no password and its role grant, and emails a single-use invite link through the outbox. There is no public registration.

The Retry action of a delivery_failed queue item (HH-INT-20, HH-COM-02). Queues a failed delivery of an automatic message again, only when it never reached the provider: a new job of the message’s own automation sends it, rechecking the automatic list, the template, consent and the record, under the same provider idempotency key, so a retry sends at most one message. A delivery that is not failed (queued, sent, suppressed), a staff-released draft or a message no longer on the automatic list is a CONFLICT. Staff with message.release_draft; an Estimator only for items assigned to them. The queue item resolves once the send is handed over.

get.description: Staff with request.view (a worker has My Day instead). Only the item types whose matrix action the caller holds are listed (own-record grants list only items assigned to the caller), filtered before ordering and paging. Ordered by urgency: safety, today’s appointment changes, overdue and other time-sensitive items, then by due time and age. Reasons that reveal restricted detail are replaced by a generic reason for roles that may not see it. No restricted field is stored on an item.

The Owner’s decisions waiting: deposit waivers, Start Work exceptions, refunds and cancellation outcomes, deletion requests, Overdue—owner decision invoices, damage, injury and dispute notifications. A caller without any of these grants is refused. Only the item types whose matrix action the caller holds are listed (own-record grants list only items assigned to the caller), filtered before ordering and paging. Ordered by urgency: safety, today’s appointment changes, overdue and other time-sensitive items, then by due time and age. Reasons that reveal restricted detail are replaced by a generic reason for roles that may not see it. No restricted field is stored on an item.

Staff with request.view (not workers). Requests newest first, filtered by state (open, closed or one state) and responsible staff member (me, unassigned or a staff id). Customer name, city, services and coverage only.

get.summary: A request: the original submission and its handling
get.description: Staff with request.view (not workers). The original request exactly as sent (services, answers, description, full address, timing, preferences, contact details), the contact verification badges (email and phone separately), coverage, the responsible staff member and reassignments, the latest qualification, internal notes (staff only), decisions with reasons, work packages, the next step, the follow-up due time and the actions the caller may take. The ETag is the request version for the actions’ If-Match. Photos are read from listRequestPhotos.

post.description: Staff with request.ask_question. Moves the request to "needs information" (from review, after a received request is moved to review). The questions themselves and their automatic notice are written and published with TSK-0051: no customer message is sent here; request.information_requested is recorded for it.

Staff with request.choose_estimate_approach. "Site visit needed" with a short customer-facing explanation (OWN-DEC-99): needs the qualification recorded; creates one work package per listed service and moves the request to "needs site visit". Nothing is booked and no message is sent: the visit windows are offered with TSK-0063 (request.site_visit_required is recorded for it).

Staff with request.not_a_fit. Needs a reason category (coverage, outside our scope, specialist assessment needed, other) and the plain-language reason the customer sees; the internal note stays staff-only. With accepted work, an appointment or money received the project goes to the Owner for cancellation and financial review (Owner Decisions) and nothing closes; otherwise the request and project close with their history and decision.not_a_fit_published is recorded for the automatic notice.

Staff with request.choose_estimate_approach. "Estimate online": needs the qualification recorded; creates one work package per listed service of the one project and moves the request to "ready for estimate". The estimate itself is written with TSK-0052/TSK-0053; no message is sent.

post.summary: Add an internal note to a request
post.description: Staff with request.add_note (PROPOSED: the request-handling row). A staff-only note, kept separate from customer messages and never shown to customers. Notes are never edited or deleted; a correction is a new note. TSK-0044 (HH-STAFF-05): its visibility class is internal_operational unless restricted_incident (the Owner and the reporting worker only) or restricted_financial is chosen; never customer-shared. A card number is refused.

get.description: Staff (request.view). Every photo with its state; ready photos carry a signed URL valid for minutes. Quarantined and rejected photos are never served. TSK-0044 (HH-STAFF-05): a restricted photo is listed only for a role that reads its class (restricted incident: the Owner; restricted financial: the Owner).

put.summary: Record the qualification of a request
put.description: Staff with request.qualify (PROPOSED: the request-handling row). One outcome per check of HH-LEAD-02 (coverage, service fit, missing essential facts, urgency, site-visit need, staff and equipment, risk flags) with an optional note; each save is a new revision, and If-Match is the current revision (0 before the first). Classification is by staff; AI stays off. Never changes the request state or stops the clock.

put.summary: Make one staff member responsible for a request
put.description: Staff with request.assign. Sets the one responsible staff member (an active staff member whose role may handle requests) on the request and its project; every reassignment is kept with who made it. If-Match is the request version; the new version is returned. Assigning never stops the first-response clock.

get.description: Staff with request.view (not workers). The request’s reference, status, submission time, service codes and responsible staff member; an unknown request answers NOT_FOUND. No contact or property detail.

get.summary: Who can be responsible for a request
get.description: Staff with request.assign. Active staff whose roles may handle requests (the matrix row "Ask a question, choose online or site visit, Not a Fit, assign responsible person"): id and name only.

Owner only (dashboard.view). Every configuration key with its active version: the value as path and value pairs (money in integer cents), or NOT CONFIGURED with the open question it cites; the source ids; whether the value is a PROPOSED reading; the AI module state (always disabled). Environment variables are listed by name with whether they are set; their values are never read into the response. Changing a value is a separate action (policy_values.change). Reads only.

Owner only (dashboard.view). Health checks read from recorded data: the database and migrations; the job queue (queued, running, retrying, overdue, interrupted and permanently failed jobs) and pending outbox events with their age; email and text deliveries; Bird and Resend callbacks; request photo uploads and processing; the request-to-intake integrity check; configuration values NOT CONFIGURED. What the system cannot observe (backups, the last restore drill, scheduling conflicts, error tracking) is unknown or not configured, never ok. Provider modes and missing variable names only: no secret, destination, payload, message text or variable value. The newest 20 failed jobs, failed deliveries, failed callbacks, upload problems and requests missing from intake are listed. Reads only.
